intuition: A trie handles fixed letters directly; a dot branches over every child at that position.

brute_force.approach: Store all words and test each against the query pattern.

optimal.approach: Traverse trie edges; recursively branch over children only for wildcard positions.
optimal.time: O(L) normally, O(26^d) for d wildcards

edge_cases: A wildcard must match exactly one character.
A search succeeds only at a terminal node.
